Calculating EDD Using Naegele’s Rule

Photo by and ©2006 Dustin M. Ramsey (Kralizec!), CC BY-SA 2.5 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5>, via Wikimedia Commons · Tammy Anthony Baker from Louisiana, CC BY 2.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0>, via Wikimedia Commons

Naegele's rule

Determine first day of the last menstrual period (LMP)

Count back 3 calendar months from that date

Then add 7 days to that date

Sometimes you add 1 year

Dmitry Makeev, CC BY-SA 4.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0>, via Wikimedia Commons

Examples

  • LMP: August 16, 2023
  • LMP: January 3, 2023
